Name: Bonk The QiShroom - Spot Retextures
Author: kry0sphere
Description:
Okay, so you can't bonk the real Mr. Qi. Very sad, I know... On the bright side, you can bonk these mushrooms that look just like him!! And get some resources out of it!!

Please note this mod [b]only [/b]retextures the artifact and seed spots. Nothing more, nothing less.

[b]How to Install:[/b] Unzip it, then place it in your Mods folder. Done!! ✨
[b]Configs:[/b] You may set both artifact and seed spots to true or false. While this is pretty simple to do manually, I highly recommend downloading the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make your life easier :)

Let me know if you have any issues!!
